record.limits_note: 1 cron monitor, 1 uptime monitor, 750 continuous profile hours, 1 UI profile hour, 100 size analysis uploads per month and 1 Seer active contributor seat. The Team plan changes that a help article applies to the education plan add 20 custom dashboards and a maximum of 20 metric monitors. The plan lasts 1 year from its start date and is not renewed: the organization then moves to the free Developer plan. One user activates one education plan, and a sponsorship covers one organization.
record.binding_note: The plan activates only for a GitHub account that holds the Student Developer Pack, which GitHub grants on proof of current student status, so the monthly quotas bind only after that gate.

identity_cost.detail: Students need a Sentry account with at least one organization, a linked GitHub account and an active GitHub Student Developer Pack. The Sentry sign-up form asks for name, organization, email and password behind a reCAPTCHA and has no card field. The activation page asks a user to sign in, associate GitHub and activate, and names no card step. GitHub grants the pack to a user enrolled in a degree or diploma program, such as a high school, college, university or homeschool, who shows a school ID with an enrollment date, a class schedule, a transcript or an enrollment verification letter, and who verifies an academic email address where the school requires one. Teachers apply for a sponsored account. Sentry support reviews the application and names the documents required, for example a screenshot of a GitHub Education account that shows active Faculty or Teacher benefits. GitHub states that teachers are not eligible for the pack, and its teacher application asks for a school-issued email address and documents that prove school affiliation. One user can activate one education plan.

record.reliability_note: events past the quota are not accepted until the next usage period unless a Pay-As-You-Go budget is added; the plan ends after 1 year and the organization moves to the free Developer plan
record.confidence_note: The quotas, the term and the eligibility steps come from first-party Sentry pages and help articles. The span size limit and the 30 day retention of spans, logs and profiles follow from two sentences of one help article, which applies the Team plan changes to the education plan. The retention of errors, the plan name shown in the app and web API access need an activated organization and are unverified.

evidence.quote: Plan Validity: The Sentry Education-sponsored plan is valid for one year from its start date. After this period, the organization is automatically transitioned to the free Developer plan, as sponsored Education plans are not renewed after expiration.

record.notes: Two routes lead to the same quotas. A student activates the plan at sentry.io/for/education/ with a GitHub Student Developer Pack. A teacher applies for a sponsored account that Sentry support reviews. A help article applies the changes listed for Team plans to the education plan, so the plan carries Team features. The free Developer plan is dev-services/sentry. The open source and non-profit sponsorship plan is compute/sentry. The pack listing at education.github.com/pack words the offer as 50K errors, 100K transactions, 1GB attachments, 500 replays, Team features, a 1 year limit that can renew and on-demand disabled. The Sentry help articles say the plan is not renewed and that a credit card enables Pay-As-You-Go.
